name: Titanium Aviators
description: A pair of double-bridge aviator sunglasses with a brushed titanium frame and temple arms and gradient amber-to-clear mineral-glass lenses.
materials: Brushed titanium frame and temple arms, double-bridge nose saddle, gradient amber-to-clear mineral-glass lenses
primaryColors: Warm brushed silver-titanium; amber-to-clear gradient lens tint
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, logo, wordmark, engraving, or printed/stamped lettering anywhere on the frame, temple arms, or lenses; no hinge stamps or nose-pad markings; no props, hands, or presenter except the plain ear/temple crop required for the worn-scale angle. Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: Keep the frame silhouette, double-bridge nose saddle shape, brushed titanium tone, and amber-to-clear gradient lens color identical across all four angles; hinge position and temple-arm proportions must match exactly between shots.
